literature.citation: Tsuji (2009), Are Investment Strategies Exploiting Option Investor Sentiment Profitable? Evidence from Japan
literature.selection_risk: The paper compared multiple thresholds. This replication freezes the paper-reported best rule and forbids re-selection on post-publication data.

signal.pcr_source: authoritative frozen full information panel from run 33611084116
signal.undefined_month_rule: FLAT for the following month; do not carry the prior position and do not rescue the PCR definition.

evaluation_sample.reason_start: First usable post-publication PCR month after the known 2009-05 and 2009-06 archive gaps.
evaluation_sample.reason_end: 2026-07 is the final signal month with a fully observable following calendar month as of preregistration on 2026-09-02.
evaluation_sample.future_extension_rule: Any later extension must be a separately versioned locked forward test; it may not alter this v1 result.

return_proxy.primary_source: Nikkei official Nikkei 225 Futures Index daily series
return_proxy.role: Phase-1 daily directional proxy only; not exact JNU micro execution validation.
return_proxy.primary_return: For signal month t, position is applied to the following calendar month t+1. Return is first available official Futures Index level in t+1 to last available official Futures Index level in t+1.
return_proxy.lookahead_control: The month-t PCR is same-day-EOD information. No month-t close return is credited to the signal.
return_proxy.secondary_literature_aligned_diagnostic: Last official level of t to last official level of t+1; diagnostic only and forbidden from determining PASS.

costs.turnover_rule: cost = abs(position_t - position_t_minus_1) * one_way_bps / 10000; a -1 to +1 reversal costs two one-way units.

promotion_limit: Even PASS is not VALIDATED_JNU_MODULE. Promotion requires independent review, regime/cost robustness already reported here, and true OSE mini/micro or second-engine confirmation under existing validation policy.
forbidden: Change 88.7 or 116.5 after observing post-publication returns.
Try other Tsuji percentile thresholds to rescue a failed primary rule.
Use the secondary same-month-close diagnostic to determine PASS.
Carry positions through undefined PCR months.
Change costs, sample boundaries, bootstrap seed/block length, subperiods, or PASS thresholds after observing outcomes.
Call a proxy PASS a validated exact-JNU module.
